newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE volume of trade up 60 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: WCE volume of trade up 60 percent in March.

text.p: Total volume of trade on the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange in March reached 189,617 contracts, up 60 percent from the same period last year, the WCE said.
Cumulative volume for the 1996/97 crop year reached 1,429,233 contracts, 37 percent above last year's total.
Trade in canola contracts was up 71 percent from the same month a year ago at 131,473 contracts. In the crop year to date, canola trade was up 25 percent at 944,800 contracts.
Open interest in canola at the end of March was 51,288.
Feed wheat volume reached 24,195 contracts in March, up 74 percent from the same month a year ago.
In the crop year to date, feed wheat trade was up 32 percent at 165,923 contracts.
Open interest in feed wheat at month's end was 10,862.
Western barley trade in March was up 15 percent from the same time a year ago at 25,910 contracts traded. In the crop year to date, barley trade was up 71 percent at 247,721 contracts.
Open interest in barley at the end of March was 14,679.
